assertions.name: 3_exponent_offset_additive
assertions.detail: 2x2 interaction = 0, so the offset is additive in Z and N -- the same functional shape as the landed law. WEIGHT: 4 points against a 3-parameter additive model tests exactly ONE constraint. Weak alone; corroborative here.

description: Bean qou-iayk. Tests the bean's blocking claim that the fresh Habiro D(u) exponents are IRREGULAR, against the recorded factorisations. Exact integer arithmetic; no floating point.
scope: scope-(a) MEASUREMENT. Refutes 'irregular'. Does NOT establish that the fresh values are correct: reading (a) of the bean, a producer defect beyond the PR #5376 parser fix, is untested here and remains live. Wires nothing; regenerates no witness.

context.refutes: qou-iayk: 'An irregular offset is NOT explainable by a normalisation, and one atom (3He) matches exactly while its A=3 partner (T) is off by 5.'
context.note: The producer d_u_closed_form_proof.py states in its own docstring that this law is NOT a test of witness correctness: the committed witness satisfies the law exactly and still FAILS the outer identity on all four atoms.
